en.content: Two particles, of masses M and 2M, moving, as shown, with speeds of 10 m/s and 5 m/s, collide elastically at the origin. After the collision, they move along the indicated directions with speeds u1 and u2, respectively. The values of u1 and u2 are nearly :
en.explanation:
2MV, cos 30° + Mv2 cos 45° = 10 M cos 30° + 10 cos 45°

   ...(i)

2MV, sin 30° – MV2 sin 45° = –10 M sin 30° + 10 M sin 45°

   ...(ii)



V2 = 6.3 m/s
